standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.npc: Hello [player name]. Thanks for your help in recovering the Accord.

steps.npc: The signing of the Accord marked the start of a golden age. Once the Royal Lords replaced the Council of Elders, Kourend prospered like never before.

steps.player: But that was a long time ago. Why does it matter now?

steps.npc: Because I think it's time for another golden age. The Kourend Council, like the Council of Elders before them, have failed to do a good job in running this kingdom.

steps.player: And you think the five houses would do a better job?

options.text: What makes you say the council have done a bad job?

steps.player: What makes you say the Council have done a bad job?

steps.npc: More crime. Fewer homes. More illness. Loss of jobs. The list goes on.

steps.player: But aren't the five houses partially to blame as well? They rule the cities.

steps.npc: The Council sets the laws and the Council sets the budgets. We have to do as they say, just like everyone else.

steps.player: Hmmm, fair enough. Anyway, we'd better get off.

standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.player: Hello there Artur. Actually... I guess I should say Your Majesty now.

standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.npc: For you friend, Artur is fine.

standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.speaker: Elena Hosidius
standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.text: You should not dispense formalities Artur. A king should command respect.

standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.npc: I can command respect without using fancy titles, mother.
I have a lot of responsibility now. There's much to learn and not much time to learn it in. The loss of father still weighs heavily on me as well.
Still, I am well supported by those around me. I'm sure that with their help, I can be the ruler the people deserve.

standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.player: I'm sure you can as well. Anyway, I'll let you get on with your work.

standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.text: If the player has lost Lunch by the Lancalliums:

steps.npc: Before you go, my father would have wanted you to have this.
